title: Paint & Pour
seo_title: Paint & Pour at Big Cedar Lodge in Ridgedale, MO
description: Paint & Pour is a painting class where an art instructor walks you through step-by-step instructions in a laid-back setting, and no painting skills are required. It is meant for creating a painting with family and friends. It takes place Friday, November 27, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at Big Cedar Lodge, 190 Top of the Rock Rd in Ridgedale, MO.
address: 190 Top of the Rock rd, Ridgedale, MO, 65739
